none: PAS KENT-235186: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of House of Constantine. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus or AE4 of the House of Constantine. Obverse: Laureate bust right. Inscription: Illegible. Reverse: Two soldiers holding two standards. Inscription: [GLORIA EXERCIT]VS. Minted in Trier (Germany). Mint mark: Wreath//TRP. Reece period 17. Die axis: 12 o'clock. This coin is in fine condition with some wear. The coin has light brown stained patina with some slight surface corrosion. The coin is likely to date to 333-334AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 62 no. 599 and Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece & Simon James, page 28-29 no. 97 & 99. The coin is 16.07mm long, 15.48mm wide, 1.85mm thick, diameter 16.07mm…
